# 1. Setup & Package Loading

```{r packages}
# ── Core data manipulation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(tidyverse)      # dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, readr, stringr, purrr, forcats
library(readxl)         # read Excel files

# ── Microbiome-specific ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(vegan)          # diversity(), vegdist(), adonis2(), betadisper()
library(phyloseq)       # phyloseq object, ordination helpers (optional)

# ── Statistics ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(coin)           # wilcoxon_test() for exact paired tests
library(rstatix)        # wilcox_test(), kruskal_test(), cohens_d(), add_significance()
library(dunn.test)      # Dunn post-hoc for Kruskal-Wallis

# ── Visualisation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(ggpubr)         # stat_compare_means(), ggarrange()
library(ggrepel)        # geom_label_repel() for volcano labels
library(pheatmap)       # heatmaps
library(RColorBrewer)   # colour palettes
library(patchwork)      # combine ggplots
library(scales)         # percent_format()

# ── Tables ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)      # tbl_summary() for demographics

# ── Optional: install if missing ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# install.packages(c("vegan","phyloseq","rstatix","ggpubr","ggrepel",
#                    "pheatmap","patchwork","gtsummary","gt","dunn.test","coin"))
```

```{r globals}
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 2,
```

# 3. Data Loading & Preprocessing

```{r load-data}
# ── File paths — adjust if running locally ────────────────────────────────────
PATH_COUNT  <- "Taxonomy_abundance_count.xlsx"
PATH_RATIO  <- "Taxonomy_abundance_ratio.xlsx"
PATH_PATIENT <- "patient_data.xlsx"

# ── Read abundance tables ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cnt_raw <- read_excel(PATH_COUNT,  sheet = "Species")
rat_raw <- read_excel(PATH_RATIO,  sheet = "Species")

# ── Read clinical data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
patient_df   <- read_excel(PATH_PATIENT, sheet = "Patient data")
sample_map   <- read_excel(PATH_PATIENT, sheet = "Sample Numb")

# ── Clean patient data column names ──────────────────────────────────────────
patient_df <- patient_df %>%
  rename(
    case_id          = `Case ID`,
    antibiotics      = `Use Of antibiotics During nCRT`,
    diagnosis        = `Diagnoses`,
    age              = `Age`,
    gender           = `Gender`,
    bmi              = `BMI`,
    education        = `Education Level `,
    occupation       = `occupation `,
    comorbidity_yn   = `COMOR(Y/N)`,
    comorbidity_type = `Comorbidity`,
    marital_status   = `Martial Status`,
    smoking          = `Smoking`,
    tumor_location   = `Tumor Location `,
    tumor_size       = `TUMOR SIZE`,
    cT               = `Ct`,
    cN               = `Cn`,
    stage            = `stage `,
    rt_type          = `Raidotherapy Type`,
    rt_dose          = `Regional Dose  of radiotherapy `,
    rt_course        = `Short or Long Course  of radiotherapy `,
    chemo_type       = `Chemotherapy type `,
    chemo_cycles     = `cycle`,
    weight_baseline  = `Weight Baseline`,
    weight_post      = `Weight Post  Radio(chemo)therapy`,
    clinical_response = `Clinical Response (MRI) (NA = Death)`,
    watchandwait     = `W&W`,
    surgery_yn       = `Surgery (Y/N)`,
    surgery_mode     = `Surgery Mod`
  )
```

```{r build-matrices}
# ── Identify sample columns ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_samp_cols <- names(cnt_raw)[str_detect(names(cnt_raw), "\\.")]
S1_cols <- all_samp_cols[str_ends(all_samp_cols, "S1")]
S2_cols <- all_samp_cols[str_ends(all_samp_cols, "S2")]
S3_cols <- all_samp_cols[str_ends(all_samp_cols, "S3")]
all_cols <- c(S1_cols, S2_cols, S3_cols)

cat(sprintf("Timepoints: S1 = %d  |  S2 = %d  |  S3 = %d  |  Total = %d\n",
            length(S1_cols), length(S2_cols), length(S3_cols), length(all_cols)))

# ── Species names (clean) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sp_names <- cnt_raw$Species %>%
  str_replace("^__", "") %>%
  make.unique()           # ensure no duplicate names

# ── Abundance matrices: rows = samples, cols = species ───────────────────────
cnt_mat <- cnt_raw[, all_cols] %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
rat_mat <- rat_raw[, all_cols] %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(cnt_mat) <- sp_names
colnames(rat_mat) <- sp_names

# ── Sample metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
meta_df <- tibble(
  sample_id  = all_cols,
  timepoint  = factor(
    case_when(
      str_ends(all_cols, "S1") ~ "S1",
      str_ends(all_cols, "S2") ~ "S2",
      str_ends(all_cols, "S3") ~ "S3"
    ),
    levels = TP_LEVELS
  ),
  patient_id = str_extract(all_cols, "^[0-9]+")
)

cat(sprintf("Species detected: %d\n", ncol(cnt_mat)))
cat(sprintf("Paired patients (all 3 TPs): %d\n",
            meta_df %>% group_by(patient_id) %>%
              summarise(n = n_distinct(timepoint)) %>%
              filter(n == 3) %>% nrow()))
```

# 5. Alpha-Diversity Analysis

## 5.1 Compute Diversity Metrics

```{r alpha-compute}
# ── Alpha diversity from relative abundance (Shannon, Simpson, Evenness) ──────
# ── Alpha diversity from counts (Observed, Chao1) ────────────────────────────

alpha_df <- meta_df %>%
  mutate(
    Shannon  = vegan::diversity(rat_mat, index = "shannon"),
    Simpson  = vegan::diversity(rat_mat, index = "invsimpson") %>%
                 { 1 - 1/. },                      # convert InvSimpson → 1-D
    Observed = vegan::specnumber(cnt_mat),
    Chao1    = apply(cnt_mat, 1, function(x) {
                 obs <- sum(x > 0)
                 n1  <- sum(x == 1)
                 n2  <- sum(x == 2)
                 if (n2 > 0) obs + n1^2 / (2 * n2) else obs + n1 * (n1 - 1) / 2
               }),
    Evenness = Shannon / log(Observed)
  )

# ── Descriptive statistics per timepoint ─────────────────────────────────────
alpha_summary <- alpha_df %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  summarise(across(
    c(Shannon, Simpson, Observed, Chao1, Evenness),
    list(
      mean   = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd     = ~sd(.x,   na.rm = TRUE),
      median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25    = ~quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75    = ~quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"
  ), .groups = "drop")

alpha_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(-timepoint, names_to = c("metric", "stat"), names_sep = "__") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) %>%
  mutate(summary = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f  (%.3f [%.3f–%.3f])",
                           mean, sd, median, q25, q75)) %>%
  select(timepoint, metric, summary) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = summary) %>%
  kable(caption = "Table S5. Alpha-diversity descriptive statistics per timepoint",
        col.names = c("Metric", "S1 (Baseline)", "S2 (Post-RT)", "S3 (Post-CT)")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, background = "#1F4E79", color = "white", bold = TRUE)
```

## 5.2 Global Kruskal-Wallis Test

```{r alpha-kw}
metrics <- c("Shannon", "Simpson", "Observed", "Chao1", "Evenness")

kw_results <- map_dfr(metrics, function(m) {
  kruskal.test(reformulate("timepoint", m), data = alpha_df) %>%
    broom::tidy() %>%
    mutate(metric = m, .before = 1)
}) %>%
  select(metric, statistic, p.value, parameter) %>%
  mutate(
    p.value  = round(p.value, 4),
    statistic = round(statistic, 3),
    significance = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    )
  )

kw_results %>%
  kable(caption = "Kruskal-Wallis H test results across timepoints",
        col.names = c("Metric", "H statistic", "p-value", "df", "Significance")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(which(kw_results$p.value < 0.05), background = "#FFF9C4")
```

## 5.3 Pairwise Mann-Whitney U Tests

```{r alpha-pairwise}
pairs_list <- list(c("S1","S2"), c("S2","S3"), c("S1","S3"))

mw_results <- map_dfr(metrics, function(m) {
  map_dfr(pairs_list, function(pair) {
    x <- alpha_df %>% filter(timepoint == pair[1]) %>% pull(!!sym(m))
    y <- alpha_df %>% filter(timepoint == pair[2]) %>% pull(!!sym(m))
    wt <- wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")
    # Cohen's d
    d  <- (mean(x, na.rm=T) - mean(y, na.rm=T)) /
            sqrt((sd(x, na.rm=T)^2 + sd(y, na.rm=T)^2) / 2)
    tibble(
      metric     = m,
      comparison = paste(pair, collapse = " vs "),
      W          = wt$statistic,
      p_value    = round(wt$p.value, 4),
      cohens_d   = round(d, 3),
      significance = case_when(
        wt$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        wt$p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        wt$p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE               ~ "ns"
      )
    )
  })
})

mw_results %>%
  kable(caption = "Table S5b. Pairwise Mann-Whitney U test results with Cohen's d effect sizes") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(which(mw_results$p_value < 0.05), background = "#E8F5E9") %>%
  row_spec(0, background = "#1F4E79", color = "white", bold = TRUE)
```

## 5.4 Paired Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test (n = 46)

```{r alpha-paired}
# ── Identify patients with all 3 timepoints ───────────────────────────────────
paired_ids <- meta_df %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(n_tp = n_distinct(timepoint), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_tp == 3) %>%
  pull(patient_id)

cat(sprintf("Patients with complete longitudinal data: n = %d\n", length(paired_ids)))

alpha_paired <- alpha_df %>% filter(patient_id %in% paired_ids)

wilcox_paired_results <- map_dfr(c("Shannon","Observed","Chao1"), function(m) {
  map_dfr(pairs_list, function(pair) {
    a <- alpha_paired %>% filter(timepoint == pair[1]) %>%
           arrange(patient_id) %>% pull(!!sym(m))
    b <- alpha_paired %>% filter(timepoint == pair[2]) %>%
           arrange(patient_id) %>% pull(!!sym(m))
    common_n <- min(length(a), length(b))
    wt <- wilcox.test(a[1:common_n], b[1:common_n],
                      paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
    tibble(
      metric     = m,
      comparison = paste(pair, collapse = "→"),
      V          = wt$statistic,
      p_value    = round(wt$p.value, 4),
      n_pairs    = common_n,
      significance = case_when(
        wt$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        wt$p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        wt$p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE               ~ "ns"
      )
    )
  })
})

wilcox_paired_results %>%
  kable(caption = "Table S5c. Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test results (n = 46 patients)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(which(wilcox_paired_results$p_value < 0.05), background = "#E8F5E9") %>%
  row_spec(0, background = "#1F4E79", color = "white", bold = TRUE)
```

## 5.5 Figure 1: Alpha-Diversity Violin + Boxplots

```{r fig1-alpha, fig.width=18, fig.height=11, fig.cap="Figure 1. Alpha-diversity across treatment timepoints (S1 Baseline / S2 Post-RT / S3 Post-CT)."}
metric_labels <- c(
  Shannon  = "Shannon Diversity Index",
  Simpson  = "Simpson Index (1-D)",
  Observed = "Observed Species Richness",
  Chao1    = "Chao1 Richness Estimator",
  Evenness = "Pielou's Evenness (J')"
)

# Build pairwise comparisons for stat_compare_means
stat_pairs <- list(c("S1","S2"), c("S2","S3"), c("S1","S3"))

plot_list <- imap(metric_labels, function(ylab, m) {
  ggplot(alpha_df, aes(x = timepoint, y = .data[[m]],
                       fill = timepoint, colour = timepoint)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.25, width = 0.8, trim = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.25, alpha = 0.85, outlier.shape = NA,
                 colour = "grey30") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.55,
                shape = 16, colour = "grey40") +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons  = stat_pairs,
      method       = "wilcox.test",
      label        = "p.signif",
      step.increase = 0.10,
      tip.length   = 0.01,
      size         = 4
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      method    = "kruskal.test",
      label     = "p.format",
      label.x   = 0.7,
      label.y   = Inf,
      vjust     = 2.2,
      size      = 3.5,
      colour    = "#555555",
      fontface  = "italic",
      label.prefix = "KW: "
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = PAL, labels = LBLS) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = PAL, labels = LBLS) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = LBLS) +
    labs(
      title  = ylab,
      x      = NULL,
      y      = ylab,
      fill   = "Timepoint",
      colour = "Timepoint"
    ) +
    theme_larc() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1, size = 9),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
})

# Combine with shared legend
wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Alpha-Diversity Analysis Across Treatment Timepoints",
    subtitle = "LARC patients receiving TNT  |  S1: Baseline · S2: Post-Radiotherapy · S3: Post-Chemotherapy",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", colour = "#1F4E79"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, colour = "#555555")
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 5.6 Figure 2: Paired Longitudinal Trajectories

```{r fig2-paired, fig.width=14, fig.height=6.5, fig.cap="Figure 2. Paired alpha-diversity trajectories (n = 46 patients)."}
alpha_paired_long <- alpha_paired %>%
  select(patient_id, timepoint, Shannon, Observed) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Shannon, Observed), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric,
                         levels = c("Shannon","Observed"),
                         labels = c("Shannon Diversity Index",
                                    "Observed Species Richness")))

# Summary stats for overlay
paired_summary <- alpha_paired_long %>%
  group_by(metric, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sem_val  = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups  = "drop")

ggplot() +
  # Individual patient trajectories
  geom_line(data = alpha_paired_long,
            aes(x = timepoint, y = value, group = patient_id),
            colour = "#BDBDBD", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.45) +
  # Mean ± SEM
  geom_errorbar(data = paired_summary,
                aes(x = timepoint, ymin = mean_val - sem_val,
                    ymax = mean_val + sem_val, colour = timepoint),
                width = 0.12, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_line(data = paired_summary,
            aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_val, group = metric),
            colour = "black", linewidth = 1.0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(data = paired_summary,
             aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_val, colour = timepoint),
             size = 5, shape = 19) +
  # Wilcoxon comparisons
  stat_compare_means(
    data        = alpha_paired_long,
    aes(x = timepoint, y = value),
    comparisons = stat_pairs,
    method      = "wilcox.test",
    paired      = TRUE,
    label       = "p.signif",
    step.increase = 0.12,
    size        = 4.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = PAL, labels = LBLS) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = LBLS) +
  labs(
    title    = "Paired Alpha-Diversity Trajectories Across Treatment",
    subtitle = sprintf("n = %d patients with complete longitudinal data (S1/S2/S3)", length(paired_ids)),
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Diversity Value",
    colour   = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  theme_larc() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))
```

# 6. Beta-Diversity Analysis

## 6.1 Compute Distance Matrices

```{r beta-distances}
# ── Bray-Curtis dissimilarity (abundance-based) ───────────────────────────────
bc_dist  <- vegan::vegdist(rat_mat, method = "bray")

# ── Jaccard dissimilarity (presence/absence) ──────────────────────────────────
pa_mat   <- (rat_mat > 0) * 1
jac_dist <- vegan::vegdist(pa_mat, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

# ── Within- and between-group dispersions ────────────────────────────────────
bc_disp  <- vegan::betadisper(bc_dist,  group = meta_df$timepoint)
jac_disp <- vegan::betadisper(jac_dist, group = meta_df$timepoint)

dispersion_summary <- tibble(
  Timepoint   = names(bc_disp$group.distances),
  BC_dispersion  = round(bc_disp$group.distances, 4),
  Jac_dispersion = round(jac_disp$group.distances, 4)
)

# ── Between-group mean distances ──────────────────────────────────────────────
bc_mat_full <- as.matrix(bc_dist)
between_distances <- map_dfr(list(c("S1","S2"), c("S2","S3"), c("S1","S3")),
  function(pair) {
    i1 <- which(meta_df$timepoint == pair[1])
    i2 <- which(meta_df$timepoint == pair[2])
    vals <- bc_mat_full[i1, i2]
    tibble(comparison = paste(pair, collapse=" vs "),
           mean_BC = round(mean(vals), 4),
           sd_BC   = round(sd(vals),   4))
  })

# Within-group
within_distances <- map_dfr(c("S1","S2","S3"), function(tp) {
  idx  <- which(meta_df$timepoint == tp)
  sub  <- bc_mat_full[idx, idx]
  vals <- sub[upper.tri(sub)]
  tibble(comparison = sprintf("Within %s", tp),
         mean_BC = round(mean(vals), 4),
         sd_BC   = round(sd(vals),   4))
})

bind_rows(within_distances, between_distances) %>%
  kable(caption = "Table S6. Bray-Curtis within- and between-group mean dissimilarities") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(0, background = "#1F4E79", color = "white", bold = TRUE)
```

## 6.2 PERMANOVA

```{r permanova}
set.seed(42)

perm_bc  <- vegan::adonis2(bc_dist  ~ timepoint, data = meta_df,
                            permutations = 999, method = "bray")
perm_jac <- vegan::adonis2(jac_dist ~ timepoint, data = meta_df,
                            permutations = 999, method = "jaccard")

cat("── PERMANOVA: Bray-Curtis ──────────────────────────────\n")
print(perm_bc)

cat("\n── PERMANOVA: Jaccard ──────────────────────────────────\n")
print(perm_jac)

# PERMDISP test for homogeneity of dispersion
perm_disp_bc  <- permutest(bc_disp,  permutations = 999)
perm_disp_jac <- permutest(jac_disp, permutations = 999)

cat("\n── PERMDISP: Bray-Curtis dispersion homogeneity ────────\n")
print(perm_disp_bc)
```

```{r beta-pcoa}

pcoa_bc  <- vegan::wcmdscale(bc_dist,  eig = TRUE)
pcoa_jac <- vegan::wcmdscale(jac_dist, eig = TRUE)

# Variance explained

ve_jac <- round(pcoa_jac$eig / sum(pcoa_jac$eig[pcoa_jac$eig > 0]) * 100, 1)

  set_names(c("PC1","PC2")) %>%
  bind_cols(meta_df)

ord_jac <- as_tibble(pcoa_jac$points[, 1:2], .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
```

## 6.4 CLR-PCA

```{r clr-pca}
# ── Centre log-ratio transformation ──────────────────────────────────────────
rat_pseudo <- rat_mat + 1e-10   # pseudocount
clr_mat    <- t(apply(rat_pseudo, 1, function(x) log(x) - mean(log(x))))

pca_clr    <- prcomp(clr_mat, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
ve_pca     <- round(summary(pca_clr)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100, 1)

ord_pca <- as_tibble(pca_clr$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  bind_cols(meta_df)
```

# 9. LEfSe-Style LDA Analysis

## 9.1 Multi-Group LDA

```{r lefse-multigroup}
run_lefse <- function(ra_matrix, group_labels, kw_alpha = 0.05) {
  species  <- colnames(ra_matrix)
  groups   <- levels(factor(group_labels))
  
  results <- map_dfr(seq_along(species), function(i) {
    sp_vals  <- ra_matrix[, i]
    grp_list <- split(sp_vals, group_labels)
    
    # Skip if all zero
    if (all(map_dbl(grp_list, sum) == 0)) return(NULL)
    
    # Kruskal-Wallis
    kw_p <- tryCatch(
      kruskal.test(sp_vals ~ factor(group_labels))$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
    if (is.na(kw_p) || kw_p > kw_alpha) return(NULL)
    
    means    <- map_dbl(grp_list, mean)
    enriched <- names(which.max(means))
    
    # LDA score
    grand_var  <- var(sp_vals) + 1e-10
    btw_var    <- var(means)
    lda_score  <- log10(1 + max(means) * 1e4) * (btw_var / grand_var)^0.3
    
    tibble(
      species   = species[i],
      enriched  = enriched,
      lda_score = lda_score,
      kw_p      = kw_p,
      S1_mean   = means["S1"],
      S2_mean   = means["S2"],
      S3_mean   = means["S3"]
    )
  }, .progress = FALSE)
  
  results %>% arrange(desc(lda_score))
}

lda_results <- run_lefse(as.matrix(rat_mat), as.character(meta_df$timepoint))

cat(sprintf("Total significant species: %d\n", nrow(lda_results)))
cat("Per group:\n")
print(table(lda_results$enriched))

  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 4))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Table S7. Top LEfSe LDA results (multi-group)",
        col.names = c("Species","Enriched in","LDA Score","KW p",
                      "S1 Mean","S2 Mean","S3 Mean")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(which(lda_results$enriched[1:20] == "S1"), background = "#E3F2FD") %>%
  row_spec(which(lda_results$enriched[1:20] == "S2"), background = "#FFF3E0") %>%
  row_spec(which(lda_results$enriched[1:20] == "S3"), background = "#E8F5E9") %>%
```

## 9.3 Pairwise LEfSe

```{r lefse-pairwise}
run_pairwise_lda <- function(ra_matrix, group_labels, g1, g2, alpha = 0.05) {
  idx    <- which(group_labels %in% c(g1, g2))
  sub_ra <- ra_matrix[idx, ]
  sub_lbl <- group_labels[idx]
  
  map_dfr(seq_len(ncol(sub_ra)), function(i) {
    v1 <- sub_ra[sub_lbl == g1, i]
    v2 <- sub_ra[sub_lbl == g2, i]
    if (sum(v1) == 0 && sum(v2) == 0) return(NULL)
    wt <- tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(v1, v2, exact = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(wt) || wt$p.value > alpha) return(NULL)
    m1 <- mean(v1); m2 <- mean(v2)
    tibble(
      species  = colnames(sub_ra)[i],
      enriched = if (m1 > m2) g1 else g2,
      log2fc   = log2((max(m1,m2)+1e-10) / (min(m1,m2)+1e-10)),
      p_value  = wt$p.value,
      g1_mean  = m1, g2_mean = m2
    )
  }) %>% arrange(desc(log2fc))
}

lda_12 <- run_pairwise_lda(as.matrix(rat_mat), as.character(meta_df$timepoint), "S1","S2")
lda_23 <- run_pairwise_lda(as.matrix(rat_mat), as.character(meta_df$timepoint), "S2","S3")
lda_13 <- run_pairwise_lda(as.matrix(rat_mat), as.character(meta_df$timepoint), "S1","S3")

            nrow(lda_12), nrow(lda_23), nrow(lda_13)))
```

## 9.4 Figure 8: Pairwise LDA Bidirectional Bars

```{r fig8-lda-pairwise, fig.width=20, fig.height=9, fig.cap="Figure 8. Pairwise LEfSe analysis."}
make_pairwise_plot <- function(lda_df, g1, g2, title, n_top = 8) {
  if (is.null(lda_df) || nrow(lda_df) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + labs(title = title) +
             annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label="No significant\ndifferences",
                      size=5) + theme_larc())
  }
  
  top_df <- bind_rows(
    lda_df %>% filter(enriched == g1) %>% slice_max(log2fc, n = n_top),
    lda_df %>% filter(enriched == g2) %>% slice_max(log2fc, n = n_top)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      score_dir     = if_else(enriched == g2, log2fc, -log2fc),
      species_short = str_trunc(species, 33),
      species_short = fct_reorder(species_short, score_dir)
    )
  
  ggplot(top_df, aes(x = score_dir, y = species_short,
                      fill = enriched)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, alpha = 0.88, colour = "white") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = PAL[c(g1,g2)],
                      labels = LBLS[c(g1,g2)]) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = paste0("← ", LBLS[g1], "     log₂FC     ", LBLS[g2], " →"),
      y     = NULL,
      fill  = "Enriched in"
    ) +
    theme_larc(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.5))
}

p_12 <- make_pairwise_plot(lda_12, "S1", "S2", "S1 vs S2 — Post-RT Effect")
p_23 <- make_pairwise_plot(lda_23, "S2", "S3", "S2 vs S3 — Post-CT Effect")
p_13 <- make_pairwise_plot(lda_13, "S1", "S3", "S1 vs S3 — Overall TNT Effect")

p_12 | p_23 | p_13
```

```{r fig9-volcano, fig.width=19, fig.height=7.5, fig.cap="Figure 9. Volcano plots for pairwise differential abundance."}
run_volcano <- function(ra_matrix, group_labels, g1, g2, sp_nm) {
  map_dfr(seq_len(ncol(ra_matrix)), function(i) {

    if (sum(v1)==0 && sum(v2)==0) return(NULL)
    wt <- tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(v1, v2, exact = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(wt)) return(NULL)
    m1 <- mean(v1)+1e-10; m2 <- mean(v2)+1e-10
    tibble(
      species = sp_nm[i],
      log2fc  = log2(m2 / m1),
      p_value = wt$p.value,
      neg_log_p = -log10(wt$p.value + 1e-300)
    )
  })
}

make_volcano <- function(vdf, g1, g2, title) {
  if (is.null(vdf) || nrow(vdf) == 0)
    return(ggplot() + labs(title = title) + theme_larc())
  
  vdf <- vdf %>%
    mutate(
      status = case_when(
        p_value < 0.05 & log2fc >  1 ~ "up",
        p_value < 0.05 & log2fc < -1 ~ "down",
        TRUE                          ~ "ns"
      ),
      colour = case_when(
        status == "up"   ~ PAL[g2],
        status == "down" ~ PAL[g1],
        TRUE             ~ "#BDBDBD"
      )
    )
  
  top_labels <- vdf %>%
    arrange(desc(neg_log_p)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 8)
  
  n_up   <- sum(vdf$status == "up")
  n_down <- sum(vdf$status == "down")
  
  ggplot(vdf, aes(x = log2fc, y = neg_log_p)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = status), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.75,
               shape = 16) +
    geom_label_repel(data = top_labels,
                     aes(label = str_trunc(species, 22)),
                     size = 2.8, max.overlaps = 12,
                     box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.3,
                     segment.colour = "#777777", segment.size = 0.4,
                     fill = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "#999999", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "#DDDDDD", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(up = PAL[g2], down = PAL[g1], ns = "#BDBDBD"),
      labels = c(up   = paste0("Enriched in ", LBLS[g2], " (n=", n_up,")"),
                 down = paste0("Enriched in ", LBLS[g1], " (n=", n_down,")"),
                 ns   = "Not significant")
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = sprintf("↑%s: n=%d  |  ↑%s: n=%d",
                         LBLS[g2], n_up, LBLS[g1], n_down),
      x        = "log₂ Fold Change",
      y        = "−log₁₀(p-value)",
      colour   = NULL
    ) +
    theme_larc() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5))
}

v12 <- run_volcano(as.matrix(rat_mat), as.character(meta_df$timepoint), "S1","S2", sp_names)
v23 <- run_volcano(as.matrix(rat_mat), as.character(meta_df$timepoint), "S2","S3", sp_names)
v13 <- run_volcano(as.matrix(rat_mat), as.character(meta_df$timepoint), "S1","S3", sp_names)

make_volcano(v12,"S1","S2","S1 vs S2  (Post-RT Effect)") |
make_volcano(v23,"S2","S3","S2 vs S3  (Post-CT Effect)") |
make_volcano(v13,"S1","S3","S1 vs S3  (Overall TNT Effect)")
```
